description: Hi everyone! I’m a student who loves programming, logic, and building tech projects. I’ve worked with Python, TypeScript, and web development. Having competed in science events, hackathon workshops, and student council, I know how to keep a team organized, supportive, and focused under a tight deadline. I'd love to connect with teammates interested in UI/UX design, frontend development, open dataset research, or storytelling and video editing to help us build a project we're all proud to submit!
